query:
UPDATE ai_projection_instances
            SET generation_user_id = $5,
                status = 'refreshing',
                next_refresh_at = $6,
                updated_at = $6
            WHERE projection_id = $1
              AND target_type = $2
              AND target_id = $3
              AND prompt_hash = $4
              AND (generated_at IS NULL OR generated_at < $6)
